I don't have a record of Mira's first steps in her memory or milestones history — the closest entries I have are "pulled to standing at the couch" (this month) and "stacked three blocks" (last month), but nothing marking first independent steps.

If she's already walking, that's worth telling me so I can save it — otherwise it's possible that milestone hasn't been logged yet, or it's still ahead of her. Want me to note it once you let me know when it happened?
